sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The gameplay is divided into levels, each with its unique theme and challenges. Players must collect all the stars in each level to progress to the next one. As players progress through the levels, the difficulty increases, requiring players to use their skills and reflexes to navigate through increasingly complex obstacles. The game features a fuel bar that gradually decreases as players fly, and players must collect potions to refill it.

The game also features a variety of power-ups and potions that players can collect to enhance their abilities and overcome challenges. Players can collect speed boosters, shields, and magnets, among other power-ups, to help them navigate through the levels.
